pages.title: Fire Beneath the Ding
pages.text: Shoot supported empty ground with a filled vessel, then place the Ding directly above that fire.$(br2)The floating essence released by sneaking does not substitute for a burning forge block. Open the Ding, insert the recipe slip and materials, and inspect its target temperature. Every recipe accepts every fire type; temperature still affects quality.$(br2)Bronze Fire-Guiding Ding and Crimson Gold Sanyang Ding have lids: sneak-right-click only opens or closes the lid, without opening the menu. With the lid open, ordinary right-click opens the menu; a closed lid prevents menu access. Leaving the menu keeps the lid open. Inserted items appear inside its basin. With Debug Eye enabled, sneak-right-click resizes the Ding before any lid action, regardless of the held item.

pages.title: Choose a Suitable Flame
pages.text: Ordinary heat supports basic forging; higher-grade items require a flame that can reach the recipe target.$(br2)Flames also have different forging properties. Some suit wooden items; others favor metal weapons, spirit attacks, or tribulation resistance. Consult the filled vessel tooltip for its actual effect.

pages.title: Heat and Lifetime
pages.text: Start forging, apply heat, and watch temperature and melting progress until an item is produced.$(br2)Placed spirit fire expires, but lasts longer directly beneath a Ding. Moving the Ding does not restart its timer. Floating capturable essences follow no such ground-fire timer. Closing the menu ends the forging pose without canceling the batch.
